translations.eng: The patient should take two tablets of this medicine every morning before breakfast.
translations.yor: Aláìsàn yẹ kí ó mu àwọn tábùlẹ̀tì méjì ti oogun yìí ní òwúrọ̀ ọjọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣáájú ìjẹun àárọ̀.
translations.hau: Majiyyaci ya kamata ya sha kwaya biyu na wannan maganin kowane safiya kafin cin abinci.
translations.ibo: Onye ọrịa ahụ kwesịrị iri mkpụrụ ọgwụ abụọ nke a n'ụtụtụ ọ bụla tupu ọ rie nri ụtụtụ.
translations.swh: Mgonjwa anapaswa kumeza vidonge viwili vya dawa hii kila asubuhi kabla ya kifungua kinywa.
translations.amh: ታካሚው ይህን ሃኪም ቤት ቀን ቀን ሁለት ጡባዊ ከምሳ በፊት መውሰድ አለበት።
translations.fra: Le patient doit prendre deux comprimés de ce médicament chaque matin avant le petit-déjeuner.

translations.eng: Please wash your hands thoroughly with soap and clean water for at least twenty seconds.
translations.yor: Jọ̀wọ́ fo ọwọ́ rẹ dáadáa pẹ̀lú ọṣẹ àti omi mímọ́ fún ìdá mẹ́rìndínlọ́gbọ̀n iṣẹ́jú kan.
translations.hau: Da fatan a wanke hannayenku sosai da sabulu da ruwa mai tsabta na kimanin daƙiƙa ashirin aƙalla.
translations.ibo: Biko saa aka gị ọcha site na nchekwa na mmiri dị ọcha ruo sekondi iri abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa.
translations.swh: Tafadhali osha mikono yako vizuri kwa sabuni na maji safi kwa sekunde ishirini hata zaidi.
translations.amh: እባኮትን እጆቻቸሁን ቢያንስ ለሃያ ሰከንዶች በሳሙና እና ንጹሃ ውሃ ሙሉ በሙሉ ይታጠቡ።
translations.fra: Veuillez vous laver les mains soigneusement avec du savon et de l'eau propre pendant au moins vingt secondes.

translations.eng: Early detection of malaria is important for effective treatment and recovery.
translations.yor: Ìṣàwárí àrùn ibà ní àkókò ibẹ̀rẹ̀ ṣe pàtàkì fún ìtọ́jú tó útọ àti ìmúpadàbọ̀sípò.
translations.hau: Gano cutar zazzaɓi a farkon lokaci yana da muhimmanci don maganin ingantacce da murmurewa.
translations.ibo: Ịchọpụta ọrịa malaria n'oge dị mkpa maka ọgwụgwọ dị irè na ịdị mma.
translations.swh: Kugundua malaria mapema ni muhimu kwa matibabu bora na kupona haraka.
translations.amh: ወባን ቀደም ብሎ ማወቅ ለውጤታማ ህክምና እና ማገገም አስፈላጊ ነው።
translations.fra: La détection précoce du paludisme est importante pour un traitement efficace et une guérison rapide.

translations.eng: Children under five years old should receive all recommended vaccinations on schedule.
translations.yor: Àwọn ọmọ tó wà lábẹ́ ọdún márùn-ún yẹ kí wọn gba gbogbo àjẹsára tó jẹ̀ nípa fún ọjọ́ tó yẹ.
translations.hau: Ya kamata yara ƴan ƙasa da shekaru biyar su karɓi duk allurar rigakafi da aka ba da shawarar a kan jadawalin.
translations.ibo: Ụmụ aka ndị dị n'okpuru afọ ise kwesịrị ịnata mkpụrụ ọgwụ nchebe niile akwadoro n'oge ha.
translations.swh: Watoto chini ya miaka mitano wanapaswa kupata chanjo zote zinazopendekezwa kwa wakati unaofaa.
translations.amh: ከአምስት ዓመት በታች ለሆኑ ሕጻናት ሁሉም የሚመከሩ ክትባቶች በጊዜ መሰጠት አለባቸው።
translations.fra: Les enfants de moins de cinq ans doivent recevoir toutes les vaccinations recommandées selon le calendrier prévu.

translations.eng: Proper nutrition during pregnancy helps ensure the healthy development of the baby.
translations.yor: Ìjẹunparalẹ tó dára nígbà oyún ń ràn wá lọ́wọ́ láti ríi dájú ìdàgbàsókè tó tọ ti ọmọ.
translations.hau: Abincin gina jiki mai kyau a lokacin daukar ciki yana taimakawa tabbatar da bunƙasar yaro mai kyau.
translations.ibo: Ịri nri ọma n'oge ime ime na-enyere aka hụ na nwa na-etolite ọma.
translations.swh: Lishe bora wakati wa ujauzito husaidia kuhakikisha ukuaji mzuri wa mtoto.
translations.amh: ፅንስ ወቅት ጤናማ አመጋገብ ህፃን ጤናማ እድገት ያስጠብቃል።
translations.fra: Une bonne nutrition pendant la grossesse contribue à assurer le développement sain du bébé.

translations.eng: You can open a savings account at your nearest bank branch with just your identification card.
translations.yor: O lè ṣí àkọọ́ntì ìfowópamọ́ ní ẹ̀ka ilé-ifowopamọ́ tó wà nítòsí rẹ pẹ̀lú káàdì ìdánimọ̀ rẹ nìkan.
translations.hau: Kuna iya buɗe asusun ajiyar kuɗi a reshen bankin da ya fi kusa da ku tare da katunan shaida kawai.
translations.ibo: Ị nwere ike ime akọọntị nchekwa ego n'ụlọ akụ dị nso gị na kaadị njirimara gị naanị.
translations.swh: Unaweza kufungua akaunti ya akiba katika tawi la benki iliyo karibu nawe kwa kutumia kadi yako ya utambulisho tu.
translations.amh: በቅርብ ባንክ ቅርንጫፍ በመታወቂያ ካርድዎ ብቻ የቁጠባ ሂሳብ መክፈት ይችላሉ።
translations.fra: Vous pouvez ouvrir un compte d'épargne dans l'agence bancaire la plus proche avec seulement votre carte d'identité.

translations.eng: Mobile money transfer services allow farmers to receive payment directly to their phones.
translations.yor: Àwọn iṣẹ́ gbígbé owó alágbèéká jẹ́ kí àwọn àgbẹ̀ lè gbà ìsanwó tààrà sí tẹlifóònù wọn.
translations.hau: Sabis na canja wurin kuɗi ta wayar hannu suna ba manoma damar karɓar kuɗi kai tsaye zuwa wayoyinsu.
translations.ibo: Ọrụ ntụgharị ego n'ekwentị na-enye ndị ọrụ ugbo ohere ịnata ụgwọ ozugbo n'ekwentị ha.
translations.swh: Huduma za uhamishaji pesa wa simu zinawaruhusu wakulima kupokea malipo moja kwa moja kwenye simu zao.
translations.amh: የሞባይል ሞኒ ዝውውር አገልግሎቶች ገበሬዎች ክፍያ ቀጥታ ወደ ስልካቸው እንዲቀበሉ ያስችላቸዋል።
translations.fra: Les services de transfert d'argent mobile permettent aux agriculteurs de recevoir des paiements directement sur leurs téléphones.

translations.eng: The interest rate on this loan is fifteen percent per year and must be repaid within two years.
translations.yor: Ìwọn èrè-owó lórí gbèsè yìí jẹ́ ìdá mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún fún ọdún àti pé ó gbọdọ̀ san padà láàárín ọdún méjì.
translations.hau: Farashin riba akan wannan lamuni shine kashi goma sha biyar cikin ɗari a kowace shekara kuma dole ne a biya shi a cikin shekara biyu.
translations.ibo: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ọmụmụ nke mbinye ego a bụ iri na ise pasent n'afọ ọ bụla ma a kwesịrị a lịzịa n'ime afọ abụọ.
translations.swh: Kiwango cha riba kwenye mkopo huu ni asilimia kumi na tano kwa mwaka na lazima ulipwe ndani ya miaka miwili.
translations.amh: በዚህ ብድር ላይ ያለው የወለድ ምጣኔ በዓመት አሥራ አምስት ፐርሰንት ሲሆን በሁለት ዓመት ውስጥ መከፈል አለበት።
translations.fra: Le taux d'intérêt sur ce prêt est de quinze pour cent par an et doit être remboursé dans les deux ans.

translations.eng: Please enter your four-digit PIN to complete the transaction securely.
translations.yor: Jọ̀wọ́ tẹ nọ́mbà ìdánimọ̀ àda mẹrin rẹ láti parí ìdúnnádúrà náà ní aabo.
translations.hau: Da fatan a shigar da lambar PIN na lambobi huɗu don kammala ma'amala cikin aminci.
translations.ibo: Biko tinye nọmba PIN gị nke ọnụ ọgụgụ anọ iji mezuo azụmahịa ahụ n'echebe.
translations.swh: Tafadhali ingiza PIN yako ya tarakimu nne kukamilisha muamala kwa usalama.
translations.amh: ግብይቱን በደህና ለማጠናቀቅ አራት አሃዝ ፒን ቁጥርዎን ያስገቡ።
translations.fra: Veuillez entrer votre code PIN à quatre chiffres pour effectuer la transaction en toute sécurité.

translations.eng: Farmers should plant maize seeds at the beginning of the rainy season for the best yield.
translations.yor: Àwọn àgbẹ̀ yẹ kí wọn gbin irúgbìn àgbàdo ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àkókò òjò fún èso tó dára jùlọ.
translations.hau: Ya kamata manoma su dasa ƙwayoyin hatsin masara a farkon lokacin damina don samun mafi kyawun amfanin gona.
translations.ibo: Ndị ọrụ ugbo kwesịrị ịkụ mkpụrụ ọka na mbido oge ozọ maka ọ nkụ kasị mma.
translations.swh: Wakulima wanapaswa kupanda mbegu za mahindi mwanzoni mwa msimu wa mvua kwa mavuno bora zaidi.
translations.amh: አርሶ አደሮች ለምርጥ ምርት በዝናብ ወቅት መጀመሪያ ላይ የበቆሎ ዘር መዝራት አለባቸው።
translations.fra: Les agriculteurs doivent planter les semences de maïs au début de la saison des pluies pour obtenir les meilleurs rendements.

translations.eng: Using certified seeds and organic fertilizer can increase your crop yield by up to fifty percent.
translations.yor: Lílo irúgbìn tó jẹ̀rìígbọ̀ àti ajílẹ̀ àdáyébá lè mú ẹ̀so irúgbìn rẹ pọ̀ sí i ní ìdá àádọ́ta nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún.
translations.hau: Amfani da ƙwayoyin da aka tabbatar da takin halitta na iya ƙara amfanin gonar ku har zuwa kashi hamsin cikin ɗari.
translations.ibo: Iji mkpụrụ e kwadoro na ajị ala nwere ike ibu ọ kụrụ ogbo ya karịa iri ise pasent.
translations.swh: Kutumia mbegu zilizoidhinishwa na mbolea ya kikaboni kunaweza kuongeza mavuno yako kwa hadi asilimia hamsini.
translations.amh: የተረጋገጡ ዘሮች እና ኦርጋኒክ ማዳበሪያ መጠቀም ምርትዎን እስከ ሃምሳ ፐርሰንት ሊጨምር ይችላል።
translations.fra: L'utilisation de semences certifiées et d'engrais organiques peut augmenter votre rendement agricole jusqu'à cinquante pour cent.
